notes: Phase-based controller (approach, descend, close, lift, carry, lower, release, retreat) using minimum-jerk Cartesian paths and warm-started IK with down_weight 0.5. All 37 episodes succeeded: the practice layout over seeds 0-20 (place error 1.2-1.6 cm), and 12 random can/zone layouts within x 0.35-0.6 m, |y| <= 0.35 m (place error 0.6-1.9 cm). Edge positions outside that band were not tested.
